steps.q: Does it make a great product or service?

views.text: In March 2025, Equity Mates explained GQG Partners is a global fund manager offering global equities strategies, including emerging markets, US and ex US, managing money for institutions and earning fees on assets under management.

episode.title: Buy or Sell: Ben Richards - WiseTech, Guzman y Gomez, Catapult, Antipa Minerals and more

views.text: In June 2022, Equity Mates introduced GQG Partners as an asset manager that scaled from 0 to about 100 billion in assets in remarkable time and discussed its founding story, highlighting how the firm was set up to manage money globally.

episode.title: Zero to 100 (billion) in six years - Tim Carver of GQG Partners | ASX CEO Connect Series

steps.q: Will it keep earning above market profits?

views.text: In March 2025, Equity Mates said GQG Partners prioritised management fees over performance fees, getting paid a percentage of total assets under management rather than on investment outperformance, outlining how its revenue model worked.

episode.title: Buy or Sell: Ben Richards - WiseTech, Guzman y Gomez, Catapult, Antipa Minerals and more

steps.q: Can it reinvest its profits productively?
Can it be bought at a reasonable price?

views.text: In March 2025, Equity Mates noted ASX GQG was trading at $2.33 and that it IPOd at about $2 per share, while 2024 net inflows doubled from 10 billion to 20 billion, providing recent price context.
